title: Null Pointer Dereference in Payment Service After Deployment
description: A deployment introduced a null pointer dereference in PaymentService.charge() when processing payments with missing billing_address. The error manifests as HTTP 500 responses for affected requests. Stack traces clearly point to the new code path.
